notizie.titolo: Appointments to BIS global payments standard-setting body and Consultative Council for the Americas
notizie.descrizione: Bank of Korea Governor Hyun Song Shin appointed Chair of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures (CPMI) for a three-year term from 1 November. In addition, the Board of Directors has extended the term of Tiff Macklem, Governor of the Bank of Canada, as Chair of the Consultative Council for the Americas (CCA) until 31 March 2027.

notizie.titolo: Gaining (and losing) currency: a global database of currencies, 1850-2026
notizie.descrizione: Over the past two centuries, officially issued currencies have become firmly en trenched as a nearly universal institution in economies around the world. But the path to this arrangement has not been smooth: currencies have come and gone, in line with political changes, periods of hyperinflation or currency reforms and, in some cases, entry into currency unions.

notizie.titolo: Scenarios for future banking: implications for profitability, liquidity and solvency
notizie.descrizione: Who will perform banking’s core functions a decade from now, and how will risks and profitability evolve? Our framework structures expert judgement rather than forecasts.

notizie.titolo: Prewar US business cycles under uncertainty: reconstructing quarterly GDP before 1947
notizie.descrizione: Official quarterly US GDP estimates begin in 1947; earlier quarterly histories must be reconstructed using annual benchmarks and historical indicators. To investigate uncertainty in these reconstructions, this paper systematically compares specifications drawn from the literature for reconstructing quarterly GDP during 1919–1946. The comparison evaluates predictions on concealed postwar quarters and separates variation across specifications from coefficient uncertainty within a model.

notizie.titolo: Building AI on credit: structures and spillovers
notizie.descrizione: Capital expenditure to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is growing fast, and a rising share is financed with long-term debt and through complex off-balance sheet arrangements.

notizie.titolo: Chokepoints in global supply chains: lessons from rare earths and hard disk drives
notizie.descrizione: Concentration and limited substitutability can turn the efficiency gains from global supply chains into vulnerabilities. However, the consequences of chokepoints depend on their underlying nature.

notizie.titolo: News shocks and inflation: theory and evidence from large oil discoveries
notizie.descrizione: We study how news shocks affect inflation in open economies, using large oil and gas discoveries with realized production lags of at least five years as observable news about future output. Panel local projections show that discoveries raise core consumer prices over the subsequent decade, with about half the increase occurring prior to extraction.

notizie.titolo: Bank liquidity regulation and the growth of private credit
notizie.descrizione: We study the role of bank liquidity regulation in the growth of private credit. Following the introduction of the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR), private credit increases significantly more in U.S. counties with a larger footprint of banks subject to the LCR or of LCR banks with greater initial liquidity shortfalls.

notizie.titolo: Inflation after the Iran war
notizie.descrizione: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy.

notizie.titolo: Competing rails for crossborder payments: banks, fintechs, and stablecoins
notizie.descrizione: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive despite significant improvements in digital financial infrastructure over the past several decades.

notizie.titolo: Geoeconomic pressure
notizie.descrizione: The increasing use of geoeconomic pressure is reshaping the global economy.

notizie.titolo: Central banks and macro financial stability in a fragmented global economy
notizie.descrizione: The 25th BIS Annual Conference took place in Basel, Switzerland on 26 June 2026. The event brought together a distinguished group of central bank Governors, leading academics and former public officials to exchange views on the theme “Central banks and macro-financial stability in a fragmented global economy”.

notizie.titolo: Offshore forwards and exchange rate transmission in emerging markets
notizie.descrizione: We study how offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) markets transmit exchange-rate pressures to domestic currency markets. Using unique transaction-level data on the universe of centrally cleared NDFs for ten emerging-market currencies over 2013–2025, we show that offshore NDF order flow moves both offshore forward and domestic spot exchange rates and widens the offshore–onshore forward spread.

notizie.titolo: Chokepoint disruptions and their macroeconomic consequences
notizie.descrizione: Rising geopolitical tensions, including trade restrictions and conflicts, are increasingly disrupting global supply chains, posing significant risks at critical chokepoints. Strong substitution effects and the use of inventories have helped to mitigate adverse output effects of chokepoint disruptions, but they often come at the cost of higher input prices. An effective policy response to chokepoint disruptions requires a tailored approach that takes account of the cause, centrality and the private sector’s ability to substitute and draw on buffers.

notizie.titolo: Money and the architecture of trust
notizie.descrizione: Money is one of the most consequential social institutions humanity has built. Starting from the most elementary monetary act, a payment, this paper provides an account of how money works, grounded in the tradition of credit theories of money.

notizie.titolo: Are stablecoins and bank deposits substitutes?
notizie.descrizione: We test whether stablecoins and bank deposits act as substitutes by estimating the semi-elasticity of stablecoin market capitalization with respect to deposit rate changes. Using local projections fit to weekly U.S. data from January 2019 to June 2025, we find that deposit rate increases predict slower stablecoin growth. To address endogeneity, we exploit a nonlinearity in deposit rate pass-through.

notizie.titolo: Transformative AI and demand bottlenecks
notizie.descrizione: Transformative AI promises to accelerate growth through productivity enhancement and automation. Yet automation on such a scale would raise the share of investment in output, potentially starving AI innovation of returns from a shrinking consumer market.

notizie.titolo: Artificial intelligence and climate change: balancing innovation and sustainability
notizie.descrizione: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly important factor in the climate transition. AI can improve energy efficiency, optimise resource use, accelerate climate innovation and strengthen climate forecasting, adaptation and risk management. At the same time, the development and deployment of AI require substantial computational resources, increasing electricity demand and, depending on the carbon intensity and timing of electricity use, associated emissions.

notizie.titolo: Chasing El Dorado: gold under shifting geopolitical and financial conditions
notizie.descrizione: This paper analyses the state-dependent effects of geopolitical risks on gold prices (i.e. the safe-haven role of gold), conditional on financial conditions. Geopolitical risks are often associated with tighter financial conditions. However, recent data reveal a decoupling between such shocks and more restrictive financial conditions, raising the question of how gold returns are affected by geopolitical shocks, conditional on the macro-financial environment.

notizie.titolo: Circular relationships among AI firms
notizie.descrizione: Between 2021 and 2025, 28.7% of artificial intelligence (AI) firms’ investment deals (by deal value) involved a target company that was also an AI firm, while 55.2% of incoming investments in AI firms came from other AI firms.

notizie.titolo: Core Principles for Effective Deposit Insurance Systems – Executive Summary
notizie.descrizione: The Core Principles for Effective Deposit Insurance Systems (core principles) of the International Association of Deposit Insurers are the international standard for the design, implementation and assessment of deposit insurance systems. They provide a benchmark for jurisdictions to evaluate and enhance their deposit insurance frameworks, with the dual objectives of safeguarding depositors and promoting financial stability.
